objects.description: No custom data types are defined in this header. The file only declares two C-linkage functions: paxcounter_version() and paxcounter_add(int,int). There are no structs, enums, typedefs, or classes to document.

functions.name: paxcounter_version
functions.description: Returns a C string representing the paxcounter library/version identifier. Typical usage is to read and log or display this null-terminated string; it should be treated as read-only. Details about ownership and lifetime are not documented in the header and are unknown.
requirements: Caller must treat the returned pointer as pointing to a read-only, null-terminated C string (const char*).
Caller must not attempt to modify or free the returned string.
Behavior and thread-safety of the returned pointer’s lifetime are not documented; assume unknown and avoid storing beyond immediate use unless documented elsewhere.

functions.name: paxcounter_add
functions.description: Computes and returns the sum of two int values. Intended for simple integer addition in the paxcounter shim interface.
requirements: Inputs a and b must be valid int values.

Callers should avoid providing values whose sum would cause signed integer overflow in C, as that results in undefined behavior. The valid range is implementation-defined but typically INT_MIN <= a + b <= INT_MAX.
